serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: Are you also taking a walk?
Big Daddy: You could say that. I’m walking back from work. 
You: At this hour?
Big Daddy: I’m a busy man, I have many enterprises in need of attending to.
You: Damn, it must be hard.
I can’t really relate to that though…
Big Daddy: It is, but da recognition and self-satisfaction is enough of a payment for all of my sacrifices.
You: What exactly are you doing? I don’t really know much about you.
Big Daddy: Well, there wasn’t really time and place to get to know each other, now was there? We have some catching up to do, since we are both men with a certain hobby.
Big Daddy: How about it? Do you mind coming to my place for a while?
You: Oh, I wouldn’t want to bother you this late, really.
Big Daddy: I insist.
You: Aren’t you tired after working so long?
Big Daddy: Don’t worry, 12 hours of work might seem like much, but a strong spirit, healthy body and a little bit of self medication can do wonders!
I guess {f_botName} will need to wait for me a little longer…
You: Aren’t you married? Wouldn’t I bother your wife?
Big Daddy: Don’t worry about that! I think she’s staying at my other house at the moment, hard to tell really.
You: Uh…{{wi}} if you say so.
Big Daddy: Come with me then.
You: Sure…
